scientific_verdict: BLACKOUT PIPELINE BUG FOUND — CORRECTION REQUIRED

audit_summary.primary_root_cause: False Stationary (ZUPT) Triggering during steady-state constant velocity motion
audit_summary.mechanism: StationaryDetector uses purely acceleration variance (acc_var < 0.15) and gravity norm. During smooth straight-line vehicle cruising (constant speed), acceleration variance is near-zero and gravity norm matches 9.81 m/s^2. Consequently, StationaryDetector falsely returns is_stationary=True, triggering apply_zupt() with sigma_v=0.01 m/s, which forcefully clamps EKF velocity to 0.0 m/s every frame and freezes dead reckoning position integration despite valid AI speed estimates.
audit_summary.secondary_root_cause: Heading / Yaw Drift unobservability during blackout. Without absolute heading reference (magnetometer or visual odometry), gyro bias and angular integration errors rotate the velocity vector away from true ground truth track.
audit_summary.tertiary_root_cause: Phone-to-Vehicle IMU axis mapping: in raw evaluation ablation scripts, phone acc_x was directly fed as forward acceleration instead of transforming through calibrated alignment matrix.

initialization_audit.verdict: Initialization is physically valid and grounded in 60s pre-blackout GNSS track.

covariance_provenance_audit.issue_identified: Phase 19 report inadvertently cited held-out Driver D test metrics (MAE 2.57 m/s, RMSE 3.45 m/s) when referencing validation-tuned uncertainty.
covariance_provenance_audit.verdict: Validation-only statistics strictly justify the base sigma_ai = 3.0 m/s without touching held-out Driver D test data.

jacobian_verification.method: Central finite differences (eps = 1e-6) vs Analytical Jacobian H_ai

metric_definition_audit.distance_source: Ground truth GPS trajectory Euclidean delta summation (NOT estimated distance)
